allowed_dependency_manifest.content: Fix an integer n greater than 1 and define f(x) = floor(n x) minus the sum from k=1 to n of floor(k x) divided by k. The task is to determine the set of real numbers x such that for every real y, f(x) is greater than or equal to f(y), and to compute the corresponding maximum value m equal to f(x).
